comment: Read from source at commit fb63bc3, the state of the tree that the installed 2.0.0 matches; the only later source commit, 53c691a, changes select and not this module. The maker's tooltip on the V/oct knob reads Coarse, which is what the panel calls it in the repository's own doc/table.md; the panel prints V/oct and that is the name used above. wavetable.cpp:110 writes each incoming sample to cycleBuffers[i / cycleLength][cycleLength - i % cycleLength], so every cycle is stored back to front and the sample at offset 0 lands one past the slice that is read back at line 128; the maker comments on the reversal at line 107 and treats it as a fix rather than a fault. The output is bandlimited per octave by the EarLevel WaveTableOsc code in src/dsp/osc/earlevel.
